proposal.description: In S_SS either overcurrent window trip sends the FSM to S_HICCUP: the run-state trip window_trip is also honoured during soft start
proposal.reason: In S_SS with window_trip high and window_trip_SS low (no hard fault), the FSM goes to S_HICCUP instead of holding S_SS or going on to S_RUN. hiccup_active and state_out change, and en drops.

proposal.description: S_HICCUP retries only when the cool-down has elapsed and the run overcurrent trip has also cleared, as if a retry had to wait for the fault to go away
proposal.reason: In S_HICCUP with hiccup_done high and window_trip still high, the FSM stays in S_HICCUP instead of retrying into S_SS. hiccup_active stays high, ss_active and en stay low, and state_out holds S_HICCUP.

proposal.description: S_RUN is treated as valid only while the soft-start handshake SS_done is held, and drops back to S_SS when SS_done falls
proposal.reason: In S_RUN with no fault and no window trip, SS_done going low moves the FSM to S_SS instead of holding S_RUN. run_active falls, ss_active rises and state_out shows S_SS.

proposal.description: Reset puts the FSM in the S_HICCUP cool-down instead of S_OFF, as if power-up had to wait out a cool-down before the first start
proposal.reason: After reset, hiccup_active is high and state_out shows S_HICCUP instead of S_OFF. With the converter enabled, the first start waits for hiccup_done instead of going to S_SS on the next clock.

proposal.description: ss_active is decoded as 'power stage may switch', so it is also high in S_RUN
proposal.reason: In S_RUN, ss_active is high together with run_active, when it should be high only in S_SS.

before: if (~g_en | OTP | latch_state | UVLO | latch_assert) begin
proposal.description: UVLO during soft start is treated as a recoverable inrush brown-out and sent through the S_HICCUP cool-down instead of straight to S_OFF
proposal.reason: In S_SS, with UVLO high and the converter enabled and no other hard fault, the FSM goes to S_HICCUP instead of S_OFF. hiccup_active rises and state_out shows S_HICCUP for at least one clock.

before: if (~g_en | latch_state | OTP | UVLO | latch_assert) begin
proposal.description: latch_assert in S_RUN is treated as one more strike and sent to the S_HICCUP cool-down instead of forcing S_OFF
proposal.reason: In S_RUN, with latch_assert high and no other hard fault, the FSM goes to S_HICCUP instead of S_OFF. hiccup_active rises and state_out shows S_HICCUP.

proposal.description: Start-up from S_OFF counts the overcurrent window trips as faults that must be absent, reading 'no fault present' as including them
proposal.reason: In S_OFF, with the converter enabled and no hard fault, but window_trip or window_trip_SS high, the FSM stays in S_OFF instead of going to S_SS. ss_active and en stay low.

proposal.description: Start-up from S_OFF waits for the soft-start handshake SS_done to be low, as if the ramp had to report its reset first
proposal.reason: In S_OFF, with the converter enabled and no fault but SS_done high, the FSM stays in S_OFF instead of going to S_SS. ss_active and en stay low until SS_done falls.
